facts.business: SuviDha Infraestate Corporation Limited is engaged in the sale of plotted lands and real estate development.

auditor.name: J M Parikh & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters reported: (1) Advance booking of Rs. 86.89 lakh from nine customers pending conveyance/confirmation; (2) Inventory of plotted lands unsold for several years, valued based on management estimates; (3) Unpaid calls of Rs. 50.19 lakh in share capital for over 10 years with no forfeiture initiated; (4) Revenue recognition under Ind AS 115 involves significant judgment on performance obligations and transfer of control.

key_risks: Advance bookings pending execution of conveyance deeds and lack of balance confirmations from customers
Inventory of plotted lands remaining unsold for several years, dependent on unpredictable market conditions
Unpaid share calls of Rs. 50.19 lakh outstanding for over 10 years with no forfeiture proceedings initiated
Significant judgment involved in revenue recognition under Ind AS 115 for real estate projects
Non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulation 31(2) requiring 100% promoter shareholding in demat form
